lines.zh: 山风穿过骨头，响得很轻。
lines.en: Mountain wind through my bones — barely a sound.
shadows... I can't go back.
Don't rush me. I have no feet.
My knees are packed with wet mud.

lines.zh: 我数着松树，总也数不完。
lines.en: I count the pines and never finish.

lines.zh: 脚下的针叶早就枯透了。
lines.en: The needles underfoot have long been dead.
The moonlight leads; I drift after it.
Don't look back. There's only mist behind.
Which way was I drifting?
I have no feet; I drift with the wind.
The mountain wind carries me low.
Daylight is too bright. I hate it.
Sunlight sends me hiding.

lines.zh: 山地的风，穿不过我的身体。
lines.en: Mountain wind passes through me.
I pass through the stone to reach you.
The crying in the hills? That's me.

lines.zh: 我数肋骨，数到一半忘了。
lines.en: I count my ribs and forget halfway.

lines.zh: 针叶林上方，我俯冲下来。
lines.en: Over the conifers I dive.
The sun reaches me but never warms me.
The wind scraped my name away.

lines.zh: 我穿过石墙，只留下一声。
lines.en: I pass through stone, leaving one cry.

lines.zh: 活着时，我走路是有声的。
lines.en: When I lived, my steps made sound.
Do you remember this face?

lines.zh: 你的影子落在松针上，很深。
lines.en: Your shadow lies deep on the pine needles.

lines.zh: 活人总忍不住东张西望。
lines.en: The living can't help looking around.
They call me Banshee. Remember.
You're standing on my old home.
The white breath you exhale is lovely.

lines.zh: 别抖，我只想看清你的脸。
lines.en: Don't tremble. I only want a clear look at your face.
That heartbeat is too loud to hide.

lines.zh: 借着你的眼睛，看一次月亮。
lines.en: Lend me your eyes to see the moon once.

lines.zh: 穿过方块的女鬼，追得很快。
lines.en: A ghost through blocks closes fast.
Pain. So I can still feel pain.

lines.zh: 魂体散了，得慢慢凝回来。
lines.en: My soul scatters; I must gather it back.

lines.zh: 我死过一次，这点疼算什么。
lines.en: I died once; this pain is nothing.
Above the taiga, I fly low.
The light has burnt holes in my wings.

lines.zh: 风从我的裂口里穿过去。
lines.en: Wind passes through the tear in me.
You're stronger than you look.
My frame still holds. Continue.
Strange that even a soul-body hurts.

lines.zh: 我的裙角被撕开一道口。
lines.en: A seam of my skirt is torn open.
The gold goes cold in my hand.
The smell of the living is too strong.
I hang in the air; my voice arrives first.

lines.zh: 我指尖的灵魂之火，甩不掉。
lines.en: The soul fire on my fingers will not shake off.
Put it down. I only want a little.

lines.zh: 我的哭声在针叶林里绕。
lines.en: My wail winds through the conifers.
I pass through walls, leaving only a wail.
I can't taste this thing at all.
I'm clenching my teeth. Do you hear?

lines.zh: 别喂我，我会一路跟着你。
lines.en: Do not feed me; I will trail you all the way.
I'll move aside. Slowly.
Passing through walls drops the soil.

lines.zh: 我穿过这堵墙，没有声音。
lines.en: I pass this wall without a sound.

lines.zh: 你从我的身体里穿过去了。
lines.en: You passed right through me.
The living always walk in such a hurry.

lines.zh: 你从我身上穿过，带起一阵凉。
lines.en: You pass through me and raise a chill.
You scatter the mist off my shoulders.
Gently. My bones are hollow.
You walked right through my hem.
My ribs ring like a wind chime.
Forever? I do have a long time.

lines.zh: 指环会从我指缝里滑掉。
lines.en: A ring would slip right through my fingers.
My hem passes through stone.
I pass through the stone to find you.
In the next life, I'll come find you sooner.
I pass through the wall; my voice arrives first.
Come closer, no, forget it.
Don't speak of love. I've forgotten it.

lines.zh: 我的心早就不跳了，别听。
lines.en: My heart stopped long ago; do not listen.
My hands are too cold to hold anyone.
A little weight in my hand feels steady.
Pocket it first, it may be useful.
My wail can put out a lamp.
A bones... not mine.
I'll take it back and bury it under a pine.
Is this left for me?
The soul fire still knows me.
Soul fire circles me and never dies.
Will this buy a stick of incense?

lines.zh: 我飘过山脊，衣服没有声。
lines.en: I drift over the ridge, my clothes silent.

lines.zh: 冷雾里，你的热气藏不住。
lines.en: In the cold fog your warmth gives you away.

lines.zh: 我穿过石壁，飘到你身后。
lines.en: I pass through stone and drift behind you.
Your heartbeat is loud enough to ache.

lines.zh: 阳光一照，我就烧起来了。
lines.en: One touch of sunlight and I ignite.
I've searched the mist for you a long while.

lines.zh: 你的热气在冷雾里很显眼。
lines.en: Your warmth stands out in the cold mist.
I waited for you until dark.
You smell of pine needles and sweat.

lines.zh: 山道上没人，只有我和你。
lines.en: No one on this mountain road but us.
Tonight there is finally meat.

lines.zh: 雾里伸出的手，抓得很快。
lines.en: The hand from the fog grabs fast.
It's you. No mistake.
The banshee's cry arrives before she does.
Run; I will count to ten first.

lines.zh: 你一回头，我就站在那儿。
lines.en: Turn around and I'll be standing there.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快，也快不过风。
lines.en: However fast you run, you can't outrun the wind.
I've chased you from the foot to the slope.
The more you run, the thicker the mist.
I don't breathe, so don't wait for me.
The grass you tread is trembling.

lines.zh: 风里全是你跑动的味道。
lines.en: The wind is all your running scent.
Wait for me. Just a little while.
I came through the wall. No need to go around.

lines.zh: 山路尽头是悬崖，你选的。
lines.en: The mountain path ends at a cliff. Your choice.
Did you hear my wail?
One step more. Don't stop.
Run slower. The mountain rocks are slick.

lines.zh: 山地的风一吹，我的哭声就散。
lines.en: The mountain wind scatters my wail.
I pass through stone straight at you.
Sunlight burns through my hem.
Your shadow stretches long behind you.

lines.zh: 这几座山头，我飘了百年。
lines.en: I've drifted over these peaks for a century.
When your breath settles, I move.

lines.zh: 这双手只剩抓人的用处。
lines.en: These hands are only good for grabbing now.
Good, step back. Again.
Did you hear the bone crack?

lines.zh: 抱歉，这声抱歉也说给风听。
lines.en: Sorry — and the wind hears that apology too.
Here. Take this claw.
Don't dodge. Stand straight.
My nails are longer than they look.
This time my nails have caught you.
I'm weak, but my nails are enough.
See? I can still draw blood.
My wail passes through stone.

lines.zh: 我穿过你的盾，指甲先到。
lines.en: I pass through your shield - nails first.

lines.zh: 我穿过墙，你别白费力气。
lines.en: I walk through walls; don't waste your strength.
Don't scream. The mountain echoes.
Don't crush the grass when you fall.
My claws slipped. Apologies.
I've gathered out of the mist again.
How many years did I sleep?

lines.zh: 我能穿过石头，却怕日光。
lines.en: I pass through stone, but sunlight burns.

lines.zh: 针叶林的夜里，我飘起来。
lines.en: In the taiga night, I drift up.
It's dark. My hour has come.
I know this sky.
This body again.

lines.zh: 松林的夜雾把我托起来。
lines.en: The pine forest's night mist lifts me.
Mountain wind lifts me.

lines.zh: 哭声把我从土里拉起来。
lines.en: The crying pulled me up from the soil.
I open my eyes and feel hunger first.
Put out the lamp. I can't bear light.

lines.zh: 这地方和我记得的不一样。
lines.en: This place isn't how I remember it.
Up from the soil. Steady now.
Fire licks me and I burn brighter.
Falling, I counted to three.
My wail sounds underwater too.
The whole mountain heard that one.
Who looses arrows from the dark?
This taste in the air is wrong.
So hungry I could swallow the wind.
The thunder knows me.
In the void, there isn't even soil.
